authentication.method: one-sided Wilson lower bound for per-effect TPR
authentication.threshold_rule: highest threshold with lower bound >= 0.90; otherwise UNCERTIFIABLE

independence_units.frame_effect: intervals use frame-effect rows; temporal correlation caveat retained
independence_units.episode: episodes are clusters; effective interval uses episode-level clustered counts; report width difference

formal_policy: formal labels diagnostic only; claim_eligible=false; selection_eligible=false; formal data excluded from all seals
